<!-- This code has been fully generated by an AI. -->

Confirms the current release is running inside Bitbucket Pipelines. Use it to gate releases so they only execute inside Bitbucket-hosted CI runs.

## Installation

### Binary

```bash
semrel plugin install @semrel/condition-bitbucket-pipelines
```

`semrel plugin install` downloads the binary to `.semrel/plugins/` and updates `.semrel.lock`. Commit `.semrel.lock` to pin the version for your team.

### Docker

Pre-built, signed multi-platform images (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`) are published on every release:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/semrels/condition-bitbucket-pipelines:latest
```

Verify the image signature with cosign:

```bash
cosign verify ghcr.io/semrels/condition-bitbucket-pipelines:latest \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/SemRels/condition-bitbucket-pipelines/.github/workflows/release.yml.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```

## Configuration

```yaml
version: 1
plugins:
  - uses: @semrel/condition-bitbucket-pipelines
    phase: condition
    args:
      branch: main
```

## Environment Variables

| Name | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_BRANCH` | no | `—` | Optional branch name override. When set, requires `BITBUCKET_BRANCH` to match this value. |

## Release Context Variables

This plugin does not consume any shared `SEMREL_*` release context variables directly.

## Behavior

The plugin checks the CI environment and succeeds when `BITBUCKET_PIPELINE_UUID` is non-empty. If `SEMREL_PLUGIN_BRANCH` is set, it also requires `BITBUCKET_BRANCH` to match. Outside Bitbucket Pipelines it exits non-zero to stop the release pipeline.
